mathematical_contract.topology_propagation: A classified split fragment propagates in both traversal directions only across a shared certified topology vertex. Ordinary vertices preserve the other-region location; certified transverse vertices exchange Inside and Outside; overlap endpoints and every other reclassification vertex terminate the run. When two exact seeds meet, their labels must agree.
mathematical_contract.local_field_orientation: For point coordinates x=Nx(a)/D(a), y=Ny(a)/D(a) over one retained selected source root a, the oriented line determinant is signed as dx*(Ny-y0*D)-dy*(Nx-x0*D), then divided by the separately certified sign of D(a). No independent-coordinate equality or primitive-element construction is used.
mathematical_contract.affine_winding: Each exact retained line is consumed with a half-open horizontal-ray rule. Algebraic coordinate order and correlated line orientation decide crossings; a collinear point is Boundary only when both coordinate brackets place it on the finite segment. Per-loop fill rules are evaluated before certified material/hole roles compose signed depth.
mathematical_contract.bounds: A retained loop is skipped only when its conservative exact bounds and a decided algebraic coordinate comparison prove strict separation. Uncertain bounds or comparisons never become a negative result.
mathematical_contract.policy: STRICT accepts only exact local-field signs, exact ordering, or authored topology. APPROXIMATE_512 traverses the same graph and may terminate only through the shared Hyperlimit 512-bit predicate boundary; returned geometry remains exact.

capability.comparison_revision: A Boolean run can be seeded only in its previous traversal direction, and a non-rational algebraic-cusp representative blocks face classification unless it happens to reduce to Point2.
capability.source_revision: One cheap ordinary representative can seed a connected cusp-containing run in either direction; an all-cusp loop can instead classify its retained algebraic representative exactly against affine regions and against any conservatively disjoint curved loop.
capability.full_fixture: A regularized two-semicircle loop whose representatives remain in a degree-12 local field intersects a containing exact square under both policies; intersection retains algebraic carriers and cusp-minus-container is empty.
capability.bounded_failure: A retained algebraic representative inside the conservative bounds of a nonlinear other-region loop remains explicit Unsupported until curved local-field incidence is implemented.
